title: Greta Thunberg slams UN climate COPs as 'greenwashed circuses'
summary: Swedish climate activist Greta Thunberg on Tuesday criticised the UN's annual climate summits as "greenwashed circuses", as she arrived in Turkey for the COP31 conference.
